agent_card.name: LegalContractOrchestrator
agent_card.description: Enterprise Legal Orchestrator coordinating clause extraction and defined-terms resolution across contract repositories.

skills.name: extract_contract_clauses
skills.description: Dispatches clause retrieval to ClauseRetrievalWorker to locate binding operational clauses (Termination, Notice, Liability, Governing Law).

skills.name: resolve_defined_terms
skills.description: Delegates term definitions, schedules, and cross-contract dependencies to DefinedTermsWorker.

skills.name: synthesize_legal_qa
skills.description: Synthesizes extracted clauses and verified definitions into grounded, citation-backed legal counsel answers.

lifecycle_mapping.question: What is the exact notice deadline for termination for Material Breach under the Final Executed Agreement?
lifecycle_mapping.plain_rest_failure_behavior: Under synchronous REST, a 500 error from the Defined-Terms worker immediately terminates the HTTP connection, forcing the client to either drop the request or return an unverified hallucination.

a2a_lifecycle_mapping.reason: The task pauses at 'input-required' to prompt human legal counsel: 'Defined-Terms worker failed on Schedule B-2. Which amendment date or cure period governs this termination notice?'

lifecycle_mapping.a2a_vs_rest_two_line_verdict: A2A provides an asynchronous, stateful task lifecycle with native human-in-the-loop pause states (input-required), whereas plain REST is a synchronous, stateless pipe that collapses into unrecoverable 500 dead-ends when sub-agents fail.
